concept: Review and integration: gratitude as an honest, sustaining practice through both good and hard seasons
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across daily perspective, expressing appreciation now, and honest gratitude in hard seasons — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what gratitude means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
